stories.headline: Anthropic Targets November IPO as Revenue Surges
stories.body: Anthropic plans to launch its initial public offering in November, later than the October debut many investors had expected, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday (Sept. 18), citing unnamed sources. stories.headline: Revolut's breach began with a stolen government password
stories.body: Roughly 680 customers were affected, none in the U.S. But the control that failed at Revolut is the legal intake queue every American bank runs.
